messages:
Priya Patel: Quick design review for a new compact capacity row that fits Min/Max, Burst, Pool, and a tiny latency target in a single line. Mock: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/2367004444/compact-row-v1.png
Alex Chen: Love the density. Main concern: latency indicator is only visual. We need a numeric label for keyboard and screen readers.
Maya Rivera: Agree. Also the Burst chip reads like a CTA. Suggest outline style + smaller text and an explicit "duration" affordance in the popover (15m / 1h / auto).
Jordan Lee: Implementation notes: keep touch targets >=24px. Lazy-render popover content and cost calc when opened to avoid perf hits on dashboards with many rows.
Samir Gupta: Billing: show an approximate incremental cost in the burst popover, e.g. "~$0.05/min per GPU" and link to billing docs. Avoid surprise charges. Default min for Dedicated pools should be 1.
A11yBot: Automated scan: burst chip contrast 2.6:1 (fail). Latency rail contrast 3.1:1 (fail). Recommend darker token or patterned fill. Add aria-labels: "Latency target: 150 ms" and ensure slider has aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow. Use role="alert" for validation errors.
Alex Chen: Keyboard flow: pool chevron is a Tab stop; Enter opens list; Up/Down navigate; Enter selects. SLO slider: Left/Right step 10ms; Home/End jump to min/max; show numeric tooltip on focus.
Maya Rivera: Microcopy: use "Latency target" on the compact row and keep "SLO" in expanded details. Rename "Burst" to "Burst (temp)" to reduce confusion.
Priya Patel: Decisions: 1) default min=1 for Dedicated, 2) collapsed pool label when only one pool, 3) show latency numeric on focus, 4) burst cost in popover. Any objections?
Samir Gupta: No objections. Add analytics events for burst changes (burst_change, burst_preset_selected).
Jordan Lee: I'll run a render perf test with 120 rows on staging and post paint/frame timings here. ETA ~2h.
Priya Patel: Thanks team. Maya, please post updated mock with darker rail and outlined burst chip by EOD. We'll reconvene after Jordan's perf numbers.
